full_text:
Prophecy or Legend? was the third gamebook based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, following The Showdown. Based on the second season of the show, it was promoted at the 2012 Bologna Children's Book Fair but ultimately never released. 

== Synopsis ==
Lok Lambert and the Huntik Foundation continue their adventure as they battle new enemies and Titans. 

== Trivia ==
*The cover depicts Lok Lambert, Powerbonded Kipperin, the Willblade and Doom Warden at a waterfall.
